## Install

Download the `.zip` below, extract it, and double-click `Elio.cmd`. You do not need Node.js, Git, or npm. Run `Create-Shortcuts.cmd` once to add Desktop and Start menu shortcuts.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app is not code-signed. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The SHA-256 checksum is attached if you want to verify the download.

Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode must be installed separately. To use Elio inside your terminal instead, see the [README](https://github.com/tursuntalha/elio#install).
